trait declaration.description: Declare a trait (ct expands it into a <Name>_vtbl struct)

struct using traits.description: Declare a struct plus a use clause (comma-separate several traits)

trait implementation.description: Implement a trait for a struct (self is the implicit receiver)

implemented method.description: A method inside an impl block; the first parameter becomes void *self

method call.description: Trait method call (ct turns it into vptr dispatch with &obj)

foreach loop.description: foreach over an array or Vec (implicit `item`, plus a read-only `i`); Map yields `item.key` / `item.value`

foreach over a Map.description: foreach over Map<K,V>: `item` is the entry with `key` and `value`

generic function.description: Generic function with one type parameter, instantiated as id<int>(...)

bounded generic function.description: Generic function constrained by a trait; call as max2<int>(a, b)

generic struct.description: Generic struct with up to two type parameters

generic impl.description: Inherent methods for every instantiation of a generic struct

into receiver block.description: Receiver-context block: `$` is the receiver and the first leading dot binds it

range initializer.description: Range initializer for an array; `$` is the current index

Vec range initializer.description: Range initializer that builds a Vec<T>; `$` is the current index
